_comment: Per-role MCP surface budgets over the canonical builtin and discovery definitions (ORB-21263). role_surface_budget fails when a role's tools or approximate tokens exceed its budget. Raising a budget is a reviewed decision: say in the PR why the role needs the extra surface. The resident role needs orbit.resident.metrics to inspect read-only mandate history, and orbit.evolution.add/list/show to record and read cost events; operator and manager include the resident toolset. The read-only orbit.resident.digest adds one tool to those three roles. The read-only orbit.attention task-level feed belongs to tasks-read, shared by every role and the default surface (ORB-21168). Its filter and cursor schema requires token budget increases in all six surfaces; only operator, manager and resident need an extra tool slot. Federation (ORB-21171) adds host_unhealthy, one sentence on the federated fan-out and the reserved candidate_read input the mux checks against each destination's live schema: about 70 tokens on every surface, with no new tool. Measured totals are default 41/~23706, operator 83/~41481, manager 27/~13477, resident 36/~22633, agent 32/~19224 and reader 14/~7614; token ceilings round these totals up to the next hundred. `orbit tool list --role <role>` reports the current size.
